subject: world_language
concept: Saying hello and goodbye in the target language
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR proficiency-band and can-do-descriptor principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student greets the persona and a few virtual characters using the target language greeting
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a greeting word to the correct social situation (arriving vs. leaving)
exercise.abstract: Student responds appropriately to a spoken greeting in the target language

misconception_flags: confuses the hello and goodbye greetings

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
